title: 429 Too Many Requests
description:
RFC 6585 §4; class client_error; engine use: used.
Trigger: The caller exceeded the configured request budget for the route or principal.
Content: application/problem+json (ErrorEnvelope).
Required headers: Retry-After.
Cache-Control: no-store; retry: retry-after.

x-response-contract.trigger: The caller exceeded the configured request budget for the route or principal.

Retry-After.value: Non-negative integer seconds until the caller may retry.
Retry-After.notes: HTTP-date form is not used. Required on 429 and retryable 503.

examples.title: Too Many Requests
examples.detail: The caller exceeded the configured request budget for the route or principal.
